record.question: Embryo can be differentiated as human at:
record.explanation: Answer C: 6 - 8 weeks. By about 6–8 weeks after fertilization, the embryo has developed recognizable human form and organogenesis is underway; the conventional answer is 6–8 weeks. Source/context note: “Differentiated as human” is imprecise; embryonic developmental milestones are continuous. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK563181/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
